title: Rosy Reverie

outfit_card.silhouette: A floor-sweeping open-front robe with a fitted corseted interior, layered over a slim column skirt; voluminous fur-trimmed shawl collar and long fitted sleeves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A gilded rose-and-feather hair comb pinned to one side, with a delicate jeweled chain draping across the forehead.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Deep crimson velvet bodice with a high neckline, dense gold floral embroidery, a sheer organza yoke, and long sleeves ending in dramatic black fur cuffs with dangling bead chains.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Column skirt of sheer gold-flecked tulle over a satin underlayer, the open robe revealing a ruffled scarlet hem; soft fur-trimmed heeled mules.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A vintage bronze hand mirror with a rose-engraved back, floating rose petals, and a subtle gold filigree halo motif behind the shoulders.
